name: Sewer main (north and east fences)
notes: Confirmed by Bronwen and the 1983 council house-drainage plan: runs about 1 m inside the back (north) and east fences and meets the manhole in the north-east corner. About 2.2 m deep at the manhole. Within 2 m: vegetables, herbs, raised or wicking beds and pots only; small shrubs 2–5 m; stronger-rooted fruit trees 5 m or more.
source: Council house-drainage plan (1983) and Bronwen's answers (27 Oct 2026)
